missionPremise: WDLL item 5 leftover: land-use inspect still cad-roll retiredStore. Cortex lane s7 adds JSON ROOT sibling landUseFact from land-use-fact atoms (same shape family as floodHazardFact: state present|absent|refused, landUseCode/landUseLabel, source=land-use-fact). PE mergeBakedBaseFacts currently copies baked facets.baseFacts.landUse only. Inspect resolver landUseFact() reads that cad-roll field. Cortex may still be undeployed: implement against fixtures. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-21_s8-land-use-surface_dispatch.md, _inbox/2026-08-21_sellable_WDLL.md finish item 5, _inbox/2026-08-21_s2-family-scout_close.json land-use-fact row, _dispatches/2026-08-21_s7-land-use-inspect_dispatch.md present payload.
completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture landUseFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy cad-roll baseFacts.landUse onto that field. A missing field stays missing (no invented land-use code). If merge returns early because facets are missing, landUseFact still attaches when the root carries it. Cad-roll landUse continues to copy onto facets.baseFacts this pass (acreage/situs must not regress). Inspect Land use prefers landUseFact when present (landUseCode/landUseLabel, provenance source=land-use-fact). Cad-roll-only bake without landUseFact does not claim the atom (retiredStore). Typed absence / named refusal stays visible. fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias treats missing landUseFact like missing floodHazardFact (try alias). Echo REQUESTED parcelNodeId. Diff uncommitted. No deploy.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Land use row / resolver. Cortex owns the atom read (s7). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt baked facets.baseFacts.landUse as landUseFact. Do not invent a zone or land-use code. Do not wait for s7 deploy. compare-facts / deriveBakedCardModel cad-roll landUse left as retiredStore for that surface. No new ingest.

fieldContract.name: landUseFact
fieldContract.placement: JSON ROOT sibling of facets / tier2 / floodHazardFact, copied root-to-root onto PeBakedFacetsResponse
fieldContract.typeGuard: plain object whose state is present | absent | refused. Reject null, strings, arrays, and cad-roll {code, description} objects parked on the root.

present.landUseCode: string from atom body (not cad-roll code)
present.landUseLabel: string or null (not cad-roll description renamed onto this field)

fieldContract.whenMissing: leave the key absent; do not invent a code; do not set undefined; do not copy baseFacts.landUse onto landUseFact
fieldContract.earlyReturn: if facets are missing, still attach root landUseFact when present; identity-return only when neither facets nor a valid root flood/land-use fact exist
fieldContract.retiredStoreThisPass: keep copying baked landUse onto facets.baseFacts so acreage/situs do not regress. Land use DISPLAY must not prefer cad-roll once landUseFact is present.

design.livePath: PROPERTY_ATOM_PATH=1 → fetchAtomChainWithAlias + fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias + mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, cortexBody) + echoRequestedParcelNodeId. Cortex-off strip already spreads the root.

copyRule.onto: PeBakedFacetsResponse.landUseFact (same root sibling, not inside facets)
copyRule.cadRollBake: existing merge of baseFacts.landUse / acreage / situs unchanged

alias.rule: fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when floodHazardFact OR landUseFact is missing on a 2xx (or on 404), same pair helper. Return alias only when it fills a root-fact gap. Echo stays the REQUESTED parcelNodeId.
alias.whyOr: After PR 175, padded gold already carries floodHazardFact. A flood-only retry condition would starve landUseFact alias.

resolver.whenPresent: sheet.landUse from landUseCode / landUseLabel; provenance.source = land-use-fact (never cad-roll)
resolver.whenRefused: unresolved with named code (atom-miss / atoms-store-not-configured); row stays visible
resolver.whenTypedAbsence: absent-covered with absence.reason/kind; row stays visible
resolver.whenFieldMissing: keep existing cad-roll baked path labelled retiredStore in tests; do not claim the atom

card.path: InspectCard uses bakedCardModelFromSheet(sheet). Preferring landUseFact in the resolver is the inspect Land use row.
card.present: landUseCode — landUseLabel (or code alone if label null)

threeQuestionGate.control: vitest on mergeBakedBaseFacts landUseFact copy + resolver preference + cortex alias
threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesIt: pnpm test of the named files under apps/property-explorer (vitest run)
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: local this lane; planner PR CI after review
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenViolated: test fail if merge copies cad-roll baseFacts.landUse onto landUseFact, invents a code on a missing field, drops a root fact on the no-facets early return, resolver claims source=land-use-fact from a cad-roll-only bake, or padded missing landUseFact does not alias integer root
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: undeployed s7 cortex (field absent on live GET until cortex serves landUseFact AND this PE diff is committed/deployed). deriveBakedCardModel / compare-facts still read cad-roll baseFacts.landUse.

mergeCopiesRootFact.falsifier: field absent after merge, or landUseCode not A1, or source cad-roll

mergeDoesNotCopyCadRollOntoLandUseFact.expect: 'landUseFact' not in merged when only facets.baseFacts.landUse is present, even if that bake is A1; facets.baseFacts.landUse still copied (retiredStore bake kept)
mergeDoesNotCopyCadRollOntoLandUseFact.falsifier: any landUseFact whose code/description came from baseFacts.landUse

missingStaysMissing.expect: 'landUseFact' in merged === false on today's bakedCortexBody
missingStaysMissing.falsifier: key present with any value including null

earlyReturnStillAttaches.expect: mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, { landUseFact: fixture }) attaches the fact even with no facets key
earlyReturnStillAttaches.falsifier: returns adapted unchanged (same reference or missing field)

resolverPrefersAtom.expect: present gold uses landUseCode from landUseFact with source=land-use-fact even when cad-roll bake is also on the wire
resolverPrefersAtom.falsifier: provenance.source is cad-roll, or value is the cad-roll code when they differ

cadRollOnlyDoesNotClaimAtom.expect: cad-roll-only bake without landUseFact keeps source=cad-roll (retiredStore); does not claim land-use-fact

aliasPaddedMissingLandUseFact.expect: padded cortex missing landUseFact (even if floodHazardFact is already present) aliases integer root landUseFact; echo REQUESTED padded parcelNodeId
aliasPaddedMissingLandUseFact.falsifier: landUseFact absent on padded inspect payload while integer fixture carried it

whatIWillViolateToProveTests.violation: temporarily make withLandUseFact copy bakedBody.facets.baseFacts.landUse onto landUseFact
whatIWillViolateToProveTests.expectedFail: does not copy cad-roll baseFacts.landUse onto landUseFact

whatIWillViolateToProveTests.violation: temporarily skip landUseFact alias so fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias only retries on missing floodHazardFact
whatIWillViolateToProveTests.expectedFail: padded cortex missing landUseFact aliases integer root even when floodHazardFact is already on the padded body

adversarialReview.objection: Rename cad-roll baseFacts.landUse.code to landUseCode and call that landUseFact.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting baked facets.baseFacts.landUse as landUseFact. Cortex s7 writes a ROOT sibling from land-use-fact atoms. Copying the bake would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Cad-roll stays on baseFacts this pass.

adversarialReview.objection: Hide the Land use row when landUseFact is missing, matching Flood.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch allows hide OR keep baked path labelled retiredStore. Hiding would regress acreage-adjacent inspect while s7 is undeployed. Cad-roll fallback is honest if tests refuse to claim the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: Keep baked path as retiredStore when the field is missing. Prefer landUseFact when present.

adversarialReview.objection: Retry cortex alias only when floodHazardFact is missing (current s6 helper).
adversarialReview.response: PR 175 already puts floodHazardFact on padded gold. A flood-only retry never fetches integer landUseFact. Treat missing landUseFact the same way as missing floodHazardFact.
adversarialReview.disposition: OR the missing-field retry; return alias only when it fills a gap.

secondMechanism.claim: Atom-chain already carries land-use-fact in chain.atoms so merge is unnecessary.
secondMechanism.rejectedBecause: adaptAtomChainToBakedFacets hardcodes facetCoverage.landUse=false and landUse null (S2 scout). Live inspect shows cad-roll via mergeBakedBaseFacts. S7 puts landUseFact on the cortex JSON ROOT, which is the flood copy pattern this card is ordered to follow.
